facts.fact: Seychelles' Cabinet approved the Seychelles Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031 on 28 October 2026 as the national framework for digital and AI transformation through 2031.

Cabinet approved establishing an Inter-Ministerial Digital and AI Coordination Committee, chaired by the Minister responsible for ICT, with focal points in Ministries to support implementation of the strategy.
facts.system: Inter-Ministerial Digital and AI Coordination Committee

SYC.note: Only a planned Phase 2 expansion of cloud and AI capabilities, with no named builder, funder or site.
Government datacentres are approved for implementation, not in service.

facts.fact: Cabinet approved on 28 October 2026 implementation of a sovereign, in-country Government Cloud on two geographically separated datacenters, to reduce reliance on commercial and overseas infrastructure.

SYC.note: No nationally owned data centre for hire in service is stated; the government datacentres are approved only.
